evidence.reason: At line 177, the code substitutes both `%i` and `%I` with the raw instance string parsed from the unit filename. In systemd, `%i` is the escaped instance while `%I` is the unescaped instance. For `ingress@crq\x2dtick.socket`, `Service=%I.service` resolves to `crq-tick.service`, but this code would look for `crq\x2dtick.service` and miss the dependency. The smallest correct fix is to apply systemd unit-name unescaping only to the `%I` replacement.
